intake.stepStageHint: This decides which admission path applies to you.
intake.stepBasicsHint: So we know who we're planning for.
intake.fullNamePlaceholder: As it appears on your documents
intake.stepPathHint: Kazakhstan's real three-tier system — pick the track that matches your situation.

trackHint.CreativeExam: 3 mandatory subjects + a university-run creative/practical exam.
trackHint.ContinuingSpecialtyGrant: 60 questions, 70 points max, competes for a state grant.
trackHint.ContinuingSpecialtyPaid: Direct admission via the university's own commission.
trackHint.NotTakingEnt: Applying to universities abroad only — Kazakhstan's ENT doesn't apply to you.
trackHint.NotTakingEntCollege: Applying to universities abroad only — none of Kazakhstan's college-continuation paths apply to you.

intake.fundingForcedPaidHint: This track is paid-only admission by documents — there's no grant option to choose between.
intake.fundingNotApplicableHint: Kazakhstan's grant/paid ENT system doesn't apply here — your funding options depend on each foreign program instead.
intake.specialtyContinuityQuestion: Are you continuing in the same specialty, or switching?
intake.specialtyContinuityDifferentHint: Changing Specialty — scored like a school graduate.
intake.continuingFundingQuestion: How do you want to be admitted?
intake.stepScoresHint: Enter your total and, if you have it, the subject breakdown.
intake.stepScoresDocumentOnlyHint: This track has no exam — admission is by documents only.
intake.stepScoresNotTakingEntHint: This track has no exam — Kazakhstan's ENT doesn't apply to you.
intake.documentOnlyExplainer: Continuing Specialty (paid) is direct admission via the university's own admission commission — no exam score is required.
intake.notTakingEntExplainer: You're not sitting Kazakhstan's ENT — no domestic exam score is required. We'll match you to programs abroad using your GPA, interests and any international exams (IELTS/TOEFL/SAT) you add on the next step.
intake.notTakingEntEscapeHatch: Actually, I'm not taking the ENT — applying abroad
intake.subjectBreakdownLabel: Subject breakdown (optional, but sharpens your gap analysis later)
intake.stepGoalsHint: What you're drawn to, where, and any international test scores.

intake.timeline: Months until you plan to apply
intake.submitFailed: Could not submit your intake — please try again.

errors.schoolStageInvalidTrack: A school-stage applicant sits the ENT, a Creative Exam, or opts out of the ENT — not a college admission path.
errors.collegeStageInvalidTrack: A college-stage applicant chooses Changing Specialty or a Continuing Specialty path.
errors.collegeBackgroundRequired: College background is required for this education stage.
errors.collegeBackgroundNotApplicable: College background does not apply to a school-stage applicant.
errors.changingSpecialtyMismatch: Changing Specialty means your target specialty differs from your college specialty.
errors.continuingSpecialtyMismatch: Continuing Specialty means your target specialty matches your college specialty.
errors.scorelessTrackHasScore: This track has no exam score to report — remove the total score.
errors.totalScoreRequired: A total score is required for this track.
errors.totalScoreOutOfRange: Score is out of range for this track.
errors.subjectMinScore: Each discipline requires a minimum of 5 points.

intake.budgetHint: Yearly ceiling (tuition + living, after scholarships). Programs above it are flagged "Over budget".
intake.timelineHint: Compared with each program's deadline ("Timeline fit") and used to date your roadmap tasks.
intake.constraintsHint: Free text used in your diagnostics and AI explanations, e.g. "need a scholarship of 50%+".
intake.budgetGrantOnlyNote: You chose grant-only, so a budget ceiling doesn't apply — programs are judged by how much of the tuition a grant or scholarship covers instead.
